title: Nightscout follower - 5 min. delay
symptom: While following Nightscout page, data is between 5 and 10 minutes old. xDrip+ appears to pull data with a delay or not frequently enough, and it never catches up to the current time, always being about 5 minutes behind.
cause: The issue is with the Dexcom servers, as stated by a commenter. Additionally, the Nightscout Follow logic in xDrip+ may not be polling frequently enough.
fix: Decrease the Dexcom Share polling interval by setting BRIDGE_INTERVAL to 15000 (15 seconds) in Nightwatch settings, which almost completely eliminated the lag. Alternatively, changing the grace value in NightscoutFollowService.java to something bigger than 10 seconds (e.g., Constants.SECOND_IN_MS * 30) might fix the problem, but this was not tested.
evidence_quote: In the Nightwatch settings I've decreased the Dexcom Share polling interval to 15 seconds: `BRIDGE_INTERVAL = 15000` This almost completely eliminated the lag.
